summary: BiomX Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to update the maximum aggregate offering price for an existing at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. The filing adjusts the unsold capacity to $5,061,000 under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, based on a $19.25M public float. Through June 16, 2026, $1.38M of common stock had already been sold under the Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The stock trades on NYSE American. This is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The validity of the shares is being passed upon by Aboudi Legal Group PLLC. As a routine equity distribution update, there is no special-situation risk-arb angle or structural complexity beyond ordinary ATM mechanics.
